id: title:Gilbert09:guide users when cdc setup hits a read only database

review.posthog_relevance: Clarifies CDC setup failure diagnostics for PostHog's warehouse ingestion, distinguishing read-only database errors from permission issues and suggesting remediation.
review.reason: Adds a specific exception message and corresponding unit test for read-only database connection failures during warehouse ingestion, improving diagnostic clarity and regression protection.
review.uncertainty: The tier is conservative; while the change improves diagnostics, the broader systemic impact or actual incident avoidance is not demonstrated by the code alone.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds a new exception message and its corresponding unit test.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies CDC setup failure when the database connection is read-only, distinguishing it from permission or superuser issues, and suggests switching to Incremental sync or connecting to the primary database.

observations.behavior: Adds a unit test for the new read-only transaction error message.
observations.posthog_connection: Provides regression protection for the new error message, ensuring the suggested remediation is present when the database is read-only.
